cases.name: native-alias
cases.assert: validate the complete Install vocabulary before creating WantedBy or Alias links

cases.name: competing-activation-link
cases.assert: existing links owned by another unit fail without replacement

cases.name: ambiguous-unit-source
cases.condition: the same logical member exists in common and selected family

cases.name: server-native-journal
cases.assert: profile retention is authoritative; forwarding is owned by rsyslog readiness; sealing creates no replacement generation

cases.name: volatile-journal
cases.assert: Storage=volatile and Seal=no; no disk-sealing claim

cases.name: server-dns-ownership
cases.assert: no Stubby or desktop app-veth activation; Technitium remains pending until private resolver handover

cases.name: base-profile-scx
cases.assert: install pinned scheduler packages independently of desktop tier

cases.name: server-profile-scx
cases.assert: one profile package transaction, one service policy owner, no role duplication

cases.name: scx-disabled
cases.assert: no scheduler download, generated config or activation

cases.name: scx-alternative-backends
cases.assert: direct and loader backends are mutually exclusive; preserve package manual fallback

cases.name: scx-package-identity
cases.condition: matching digest but unexpected Package or Architecture field

cases.name: nfs-timeout
cases.condition: package child times out and a detached descendant cannot be accounted for
cases.expect: bounded direct-child wait; outcome unknown; retain service inhibitor, exact backup and private staging

cases.name: nfs-policy-replacement
cases.condition: service inhibitor inode is replaced while the transaction is active
cases.expect: do not overwrite competing policy; retain backup and recovery receipt

cases.name: child-pinning-unavailable
cases.assert: no numeric PID fallback; retain private recovery and fail distinctly

cases.name: filen-pipe-inheritance
cases.condition: the leader exits but a descendant keeps stdout open
cases.expect: total deadline and bounded cleanup; no unbounded communicate or context-manager wait

cases.name: redirect-boundary
cases.condition: an intermediate redirect leaves the approved artifact host set

cases.name: transfer-time-budget
cases.assert: streaming, retries, redirects and final wait share the operation deadline

cases.name: profile-package-cancellation
cases.assert: retain running journal, archives and service-policy backup; no automatic retry

cases.name: diagnostic-unarmed
cases.assert: staged debugsys CLI and unit do not create an armed marker or collect host data

cases.name: server-skeleton
cases.assert: Bash-only startup; no seatd, Labwc user unit, Zsh, Starship or desktop credential activation

cases.name: common-security-baseline
cases.assert: auditd, audispd-plugins, AppArmor, nftables, Fail2ban and native logging packages come from the suite APT fragment

cases.name: removed-security-selector
cases.expect: unknown class rejected; no hidden fallback or security group

cases.name: single-audit-policy
cases.assert: one common auditd config and expanded native-ABI integrity rule set; no duplicate per-family publication

cases.name: desktop-audit-notifications
cases.assert: apparmor-notify is in each desktop class and absent from headless server package plans

cases.name: headless-incus
cases.assert: one common virtualization phase; no desktop Web UI dependency or desktop skeleton publication

cases.name: runner-incus-authority
cases.assert: CI accounts never receive devops, kvm, incus or incus-admin groups

cases.name: incus-active-uplink
cases.assert: managed NAT bridge has no physical bridge attachment; forwarding uses the active Ethernet/Wi-Fi host route

cases.name: incus-storage-identity
cases.condition: existing pool root has unexpected owner/group/mode
cases.expect: refuse before tmpfiles; no reset or broad ownership repair

cases.name: incus-worker-timeout
cases.expect: pin leader before session validation; bounded group cleanup; retain transaction and return 76

cases.name: incus-api-uncertainty
cases.expect: retain intent and configuration digest; no automatic retry

cases.name: incus-explicit-recovery
cases.expect: read-only verification acknowledges only matching complete state and exact journal identity

cases.name: incus-policy-replacement
cases.expect: changed config digest refuses mutation or recovery acknowledgement

cases.name: incus-common-backend
cases.assert: common host bootstrap and its AppArmor profile contain only storage/network/socket backend contracts; no UI package, graphical wrapper, browser or menu dependency

cases.name: incus-desktop-integration
cases.assert: desktop.virtualization follows os.virtualization and desktop.storage before desktop.session; Desktop UI package data and 72-incus.sh remain desktop-owned

cases.name: incus-server-no-ui
cases.assert: server keeps native private HOME client configuration; no desktop.virtualization stage, Web UI package, menu or desktop profile

cases.name: incus-enforced-backend
cases.assert: service explicitly requires AppArmorProfile=incus-host; family mode catalogues keep the privileged backend enforced independently of desktop application mode

cases.name: desktop-incus-ui-probe-owner
cases.assert: only the desktop virtualisation stage publishes its separate UI check helper, service, confinement and broker dependency; the common backend never probes /ui/
